items.text: Today at the Ministry of Defence, Chris Van Hollen met with top officers to discuss recent security threats. We spent hours brainstorming strategies for our nation's safety. Outside, I saw smoke rising from a nearby refinery; reminded me again how important these official meetings are in this fast-paced world.
